people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Michmethath
people.line: A place on the borders of Ephraim and Manasseh

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

people.name: Tappuah
people.line: Canaanite city allotted to Ephraim and Manasseh

translations.web: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.
translations.bsb: Now the border of Manasseh went from Asher to Michmethath near Shechem, then southward to include the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
translations.kjv: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.
translations.asv: And the border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem; and the border went along to the right hand, unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
